minutes.headline: Commission continued a contested Hickory Hills fence request to Oct 2 and ordered 40 Fire Road 12 corrected within two weeks.
minutes.summary: The Commission approved removal of dead trees at 70 Horizon Island Road, and continued the 372 Townsend Harbor Road fence and arborvitae request after an abutter objected and members asked for natural plantings or split rail within the 30-foot zone. It approved an administrative determination and a certificate of compliance, voted an enforcement order at 40 Fire Road 12, and arranged a site visit at 390 Howard Street. Staff also walked through the OpenGov permitting system.

public_comment.topic: New planning director introduced himself and offered support to the land use boards and the Commission.
Abutter objected to the proposed vinyl fence and arborvitae at 372 Townsend Harbor Road: blocked lake view, no prior fence on the property line, height and setback.
Gave name and address for the record; raised front-yard fence height, setback close to the water, and which side faces her property.
Clarified where the earlier wooden fence stood and that the proposed fence is entirely new.
Peninsula Drive homeowner asked what an RDA is regarding removal of three healthy white pines.

what_happened.line: The Commission voted an enforcement order at 40 Fire Road 12: finish the order of conditions within two weeks or face day-to-day fines.
The Commission continued the 372 Townsend Harbor Road fence and arborvitae request to October 2 after an abutter objected.
The applicant at 372 Townsend Harbor Road must bring a revised plan with a 30-foot line, fence types, a planting list and building inspector sign-off.
The Commission approved tree removal at 70 Horizon Island Road, an administrative determination at 160 Sunset Lane, and a certificate of compliance at 318 Page Street.
Members agreed a site visit at 390 Howard Street within two weeks over erosion control violations, with a report on October 2.

why_it_matters: Work near wetlands and lakes needs Commission review, and a neighbor's objection can delay a fence or planting plan by weeks.
An enforcement order with daily fines shows what happens when conditions on a permit are not completed: the owner faces a penalty that accrues each day.
watch_next: October 2: revised 372 Townsend Harbor Road plan due, with a 7 pm retention pond update and the 390 Howard Street site visit report.
The two-week deadline for 40 Fire Road 12 to complete its order of conditions, after which daily fines can apply.
